_notes: Data only: run.py consumes this file. Placeholders in args: {plugin_dir}, {max_budget_usd}. Placeholders in prompt_template: {task_md}, {test_command}.
The prompt is sent on stdin (claude -p with no positional prompt) so the variadic --allowedTools flag cannot swallow it.

ASSUMED, not exercised (no live runs were made): that `--setting-sources project` keeps the user-level enabledPlugins out of the plugin-disabled recipe, and the exact keys of the JSON result (total_cost_usd, usage, duration_ms, num_turns, is_error, result, session_id).

single-agent.description: Plain Claude Code session, Thaliris plugin not loaded, no delegation.

adaptive.description: Thaliris plugin loaded; the agent decides for itself whether and how to delegate.

delegated.description: Thaliris plugin loaded; the main session acts as Controller and delegates all implementation to a thaliris:implementer subagent.
